title: Outdoor Comfort Score vs Humidity Correlation
dataSources: Weather-station readings (`weatherstation:reading`), daily weather-impact rollups (`personalweather:daily`), sleep correlation records (`personalweather:sleep`), step correlation records (`personalweather:steps`), mood correlation records (`personalweather:mood`).
app: Local weather-station readings correlated with personal sleep, steps, mood, and outdoor-activity summaries in Splunk via scripted inputs and daily rollups.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=personalweather:daily
| stats avg(outdoor_comfort_score) as metric_value avg(humidity_pct) as avg_humidity by day
| stats corr(metric_value, avg_humidity) as corr_value
description: Measures whether humidity is a meaningful driver of changes in outdoor comfort score.
value: Humidity can matter more than temperature for comfort, sleep, or activity, so it deserves its own correlation view.
implementation: Include indoor or outdoor humidity consistently from the same weather source when building the daily rollups.
visualization: Single-value correlation panel for outdoor comfort score versus humidity.
grandmaExplanation: It blends whether muggy days usually help or hurt your outdoor comfort score.
